Import reads FILE, one JSON object a line: {"term", "canonical",
"definition", "confusables", "provenance": ["path:line", ...],
"lay_phrasings": [...]}. Each row's provenance names the entities it is
about (a path relative to the file's directory or a project, an absolute
path, or an id; the line is dropped); a row without one goes to the
entities its canonical name already labels. Its lay phrasings become ask
labels and its term and canonical name alternative labels, with the
definition and confusables kept as the labels' evidence. Rows that
resolve to no entity are skipped and counted.

Usage:
  agent index lexicon import FILE [flags]

Examples:
  agent index lexicon import docs/lexicon.jsonl
  agent index lexicon import lexicon.jsonl --json

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for import
      --json   Print the import's report as JSON

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
